deficiencies.why_unproven: No independent processes or network transport were used; quorum logic was exercised in one Node.js process.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: The estate has event dispatch and node carriers but no admitted replica transport, membership service, term/leader protocol, durable replicated log, or partition harness.

deficiencies.why_unproven: Majority acknowledgements do not detect malicious replicas, forged signatures, conflicting signed votes or adversarial leaders.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: No cryptographic replica identity, signed vote protocol, view change, Byzantine quorum certificate, slashing/quarantine or adversarial transport exists.
required_evidence: f Byzantine nodes within declared n/f model

deficiencies.why_unproven: node_id and runner labels are logical identifiers and can be copied.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: No TPM/Secure Enclave attestation or independently verified host key binding is wired to admission.

deficiencies.why_unproven: No live self-hosted runner registration/readback was observed.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: Registration requires target-host execution and GitHub-issued registration/JIT authority unavailable to repository source alone.

deficiencies.why_unproven: Apps Script source exists but no bound installable trigger execution/readback was observed.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: The script project, trigger authorization and Script Properties are external account state.

deficiencies.why_unproven: A fsync-backed local journal now survives reopen and detects tampering, but no power-loss or replicated-storage test was executed.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: No target filesystem/volume contract, crash harness, replicated persistence layer or independent storage readback exists.
missing_architecture: atomic replacement protocol where snapshots used

deficiencies.why_unproven: Report 03 mechanics do not publish or consume a versioned global IL-LLM delta.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: No canonical IL-LLM publisher/subscriber contract is connected to these node events.

deficiencies.why_unproven: Current stableHash recursively sorts object keys but does not implement the complete JCS/I-JSON serialization rules.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: The original hashing helper targeted deterministic local fixtures rather than standards-level cross-language canonicalization.

deficiencies.why_unproven: Persistent self-hosted runner service does not provide a clean execution environment per job.
deficiencies.why_why_unaddressed: No ephemeral/JIT runner lifecycle, VM/container isolation boundary, secret broker or external log pipeline is installed.
